notes.title: Max Twist Update 1.2 Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/h1][p]It’s been a while since our last update, but we’re back and excited to share what’s next for [b][i]Max Twist[/i][/b]! Our team has been quietly fixing issues behind the scenes, and we’re now preparing to roll out [b]Update 1.2[/b].[/p][h1]Here’s what’s coming in Update 1.2[/h1][list][*][p][i]Fixes for several [b]scoring bugs[/b] that affected gameplay.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Removal of the [b]“forever twist”[/b] [b]exploit[/b] we discovered.[/p][/*][*][p][i]A refreshed [b]start menu and splash screen[/b] for a cleaner look.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Removal of the in-game [b]EULA agreement screen[/b] to streamline your experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We know it’s been some time since our last patch, but we’re committed to improving the game and making it the best version of itself. Thank you for your patience and support—[b]we can’t wait for you to try the new update when it launches![/b][/h3][h3][b]Stay tuned,[/b]
[i]The Max Twist Dev Team[/i][/h3]

notes.title: Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Black Sun Games is happy to announce that Max Twist will be going on sale with the Steam Summer Sale!
We hope you enjoy the game and keep looking out for our latest updates! Keep it Twisted!

notes.title: Update 1.1 Live!
notes.notes:
Update 1.1 Announcement!

The first big update to Max Twist has been Implemented!

This update features:

A brand new game mode: Slalom Mode!
A new unlockable board
Balanced gameplay mechanics
New visual features
Updated textures
Bug fixes


This is just a short list of future updates and additions we have been working on for Max Twist. Stay tuned for future update announcements and keep it twisted!

notes.title: Quest and Quest 2 Support Available for Max Twist
notes.notes:
[b]BIG NEWS![/b]

[b]Max Twist[/b] is now available on the [b]Meta Quest[/b], and [b]Meta Quest 2[/b] through [b]Steam Link[/b]! Get it in the [b]Steam Store[/b] now!

Stay tuned for more [b]Max Twist[/b] updates, and [i]keep it twisted[/i]!
